items.source: Use a Cursor to iterate over elements in set at key.

items.source: Remove given values from set at key and return the number of removed elements.
items.translation: 从集合中移除指定键key对应的给定values，并返回被移除的元素数量。

items.source: Union all sets at given keys and store result in destKey.
items.translation: 将给定 `<code>keys` 的所有集合合并，并将结果存储在 `<code>destKey` 中。

items.source: Diff all sets for given keys.

items.source: Returns the members intersecting all given sets at keys.
items.translation: 返回在给定键keys处与所有集合相交的成员。

items.source: Get all elements of set at key.
items.translation: 获取集合中key的所有元素。

items.source: Remove and return a random member from set at key.
items.translation: 从集合 `key` 中移除并返回一个随机成员。

items.source: Get random element from set at key.
items.translation: 从集合中获取 `key` 对应的随机元素。

items.source: Union all sets at given keys.
items.translation: 在指定的 `<code>keys` 处合并所有集合。

items.source: Returns the cardinality of the set which would result from the intersection of all the given sets.
items.translation: 返回所有给定集合交集所得集合的基数。
